data.gender_notes: Mutahhir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mutahhir is an Arabic name, derived from the root 'tahhara', which means 'to purify'. Therefore, Mutahhir means 'the one who purifies'. The name Mutahhir carries the meaning “The one who purifies” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Mutahhir usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who purifies and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Mutahhir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The one who purifies.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mutahhir total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
